lines.zh: 我把身体拉长，慢慢往前
lines.en: I stretch my body and ease forward.
A bright trail stays behind me.

lines.zh: 我的触角先探出去，身体才跟上
lines.en: My tentacles probe first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 我在叶子上爬，叶子晃了
lines.en: I crawl on a leaf and it sways.

lines.zh: 我的身体起伏着往前推
lines.en: My body ripples forward.
I cross a twig, very slowly.
Half of my body still hangs.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头滑到另一块
lines.en: I slide from stone to stone.
The slime shines a little in the sun.

lines.zh: 我遇到一片干地，绕开了
lines.en: I meet dry ground and go around.
I can shrink my body very short.
I hug the ground, afraid of drying.

lines.zh: 我从一道水沟边上绕过去
lines.en: I go around the edge of a ditch.

lines.zh: 我贴在树皮上，慢慢上移
lines.en: I cling to bark and move slowly up.

lines.zh: 我的身体在叶脉上找路
lines.en: I feel for a path along the leaf veins.

lines.zh: 我停下，把身体拉直了一点
lines.en: I stop and straighten my body.
I stop beneath a leaf.
I press my body to the damp moss.
I curl into a small lump.
There is water on the leaf; I press to it.
I slowly extend two tentacles.
My surface stirs faintly.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫从我旁边过去
lines.en: A beetle passes beside me.
I hide among the moss.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来又放下去
lines.en: I lift my head and lower it again.
A leaf blocks me.

lines.zh: 我的亮痕在后面慢慢干
lines.en: My trail dries slowly behind me.
I rest on wet moss.
I extend my tentacles toward you.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴在地上不动
lines.en: My body lies flat and still.
You are so big; I dare not move.
I slowly retract under the leaf.

lines.zh: 你抬手的影子盖住我了
lines.en: Your raised hand's shadow covers me.
I try an inch forward.

lines.zh: 我的触角碰到你的鞋边
lines.en: My tentacle touches your shoe.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，我连牙都没有
lines.en: I do not bite; I have no teeth at all.
I peer over the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 你的脚比我见过的石头都大
lines.en: Your foot is bigger than any stone I know.
My trail breaks off at the leaf's edge.
A small piece of my body is gone.
I crawl slowly under the leaf.
My tentacles stay withdrawn a long while.
I press flat and shrink small.
My trail breaks off.

lines.zh: 我的触角半天没伸出来
lines.en: My tentacles stay in a long while.
I edge slowly toward the damp.

lines.zh: 我的身体有点不听使唤
lines.en: My body will not quite obey.
I curl my body into a ball.
Is there water by your hand?

lines.zh: 叶子上的东西我吃一点
lines.en: I will eat a little of what is on the leaf.
Your hand is a little damp.
I will not snatch; I crawl slowly.
My tentacles stretch toward you.
I leave a bright trail on the leaf.
I extend a tentacle to sniff.
That smell is damp.
It will take me a long while to crawl over.
I am not rushed; slowly does it.
You step beside me and the mud sinks.
You bump me and I curl up.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你鞋上留下一道亮
lines.en: My body leaves a bright line on your shoe.
I roll over and right myself.

lines.zh: 我黏在你的鞋底上，被带走
lines.en: I stick to your sole and am carried off.
You move and I am rolled over.

lines.zh: 我的黏液在你鞋上亮了一下
lines.en: My slime shines on your shoe.

lines.zh: 我从你的脚边滑到一边
lines.en: I slide from your foot to one side.
The knock makes me flinch inward.
I stop in your footprint.

lines.zh: 另一条从叶子那边爬来
lines.en: Another one crawls from the far side of the leaf.
We touch tentacles first.

lines.zh: 我们的身体并在一起，很慢
lines.en: Our bodies lie together, slowly.
She crawls a little steadier than me.
Where I crawl, a bright trail stays.
Her body is shorter than mine.
We crawl across the moss side by side.

lines.zh: 她把触角搭在我的触角上
lines.en: She lays her tentacles on mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起在一块石头下面躲太阳
lines.en: We shelter from the sun under one stone.

lines.zh: 我们爬得很慢，谁也不催
lines.en: We crawl slowly, neither hurrying the other.

lines.zh: 我把身体弯过去，包住它
lines.en: I bend my body around it.
It is much smaller than me.
I try to bring it to my mouth.
It catches against my side.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈才把它摆正
lines.en: I go half around before it sits right.
I go around and ring it with my body.

lines.zh: 它在我身体下面，推着走
lines.en: It sits beneath me, pushed along.
I lift my front half to look.
I nudge it to the leaf's edge.
It falls off; I do not follow.
My tentacles have all withdrawn.
I press my body flatter.
I edge toward the leaf's rim.
I draw my body into a small lump.

lines.zh: 我的亮痕在身后干了一点
lines.en: My trail dries a little behind me.
I slowly turn around.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水在往我这边流
lines.en: The water on the leaf runs my way.
I hide in a hollow of the leaf veins.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我就不动了
lines.en: Your shadow covers me; I go still.
I try another inch forward.
My tentacles point your way.

lines.zh: 地上有我的痕，你也会看见
lines.en: My trail is on the ground; you will see it.

lines.zh: 我往上爬，爬到叶子背面
lines.en: I climb up onto the leaf's underside.
I am slow, but I never stop shifting.
I shift forward bit by bit, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身体一路留下亮痕
lines.en: My body leaves a shining trail.

lines.zh: 你走到哪里，痕迹就到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, the trail follows.
I watch from under the leaf.
I crawl along the leaf edge, around you.

lines.zh: 我的亮痕指着我来的路
lines.en: My trail shows where I have been.
I rest a while, then move.

lines.zh: 你在找我的痕，我藏在叶下
lines.en: You look for my trail; I hide beneath the leaf.
Only one leaf lies between us.
I press to the vein where it is dark.
You lift a foot and I draw back.
I am at the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我一点一点把距离缩短
lines.en: Bit by bit I shorten the gap.

lines.zh: 我的身体在叶上几乎看不出来
lines.en: On the leaf my body is nearly invisible.
I bump my body into you, very lightly.
My slime smears on your hand.
I crawl onto your foot, cool.
This hardly counts as a blow.

lines.zh: 我把身体压下去，贴着你
lines.en: I press my body down against you.
My slime makes your hand slip.
I crawl onto the top of your foot.
My bump carries almost no force.
I withdraw, and crawl up again.
This one is cool enough to make you pull back.
I come out of the moss.
My tentacles show first.
A bright trail is left on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从前面的湿苔钻出去
lines.en: I squeeze out of the wet moss ahead.
Water drips from the leaf above.
I stop where it is damp.

lines.zh: 我从叶子的褶皱里爬出来
lines.en: I crawl out of a fold in the leaf.
I stretch out, head first.
My trail starts at the leaf's edge.
A drop of water falls on me.

lines.zh: 火光让我的身体皱起来
lines.en: The heat makes my body wrinkle.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，落在苔上
lines.en: I fall off the leaf onto the moss.
Too much water; I cannot right myself.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹到石头上，黏住了
lines.en: The blast throws me onto a stone and I stick.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过我的身体，留了道白
lines.en: Something grazes me, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我身体一阵乱动
lines.en: That force sets my body writhing.

lines.zh: 我越来越细，亮痕也淡了
lines.en: I grow thinner and my trail fades.
Lightning flashes and I press to the ground.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我一路往下滑
lines.en: The ground is gone; I slide down and down.
